Summary: Angels are created spiritual beings who worship God, carry out His commands, and minister to His people. Scripture shows them as messengers, guardians, and warriors, yet always pointing attention to God rather than themselves. Believers respect angels biblically without worshiping them, rejoicing that they rejoice over every sinner who repents.
KeyPassages: Psalm 91:11; Psalm 103:20; Daniel 10; Luke 2:10-14; Hebrews 1:14; Hebrews 13:2; Revelation 22:8-9
RelatedDoctrines: Angels; Spiritual Warfare; Ministry of Angels
RelatedQuestions: Do people become angels when they die?; Do angels still appear today?
